thread:
incident-bot: Alert: elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/embeddings (prod, us-west1) — error rate 8.4% over 5m, P50 latency 120ms, P95 1.2s. Auto-escalating to on-call.

sam (oncall): ack — investigating. Posting immediate mitigation plan.

sam (oncall): quick question — is this bounded to embeddings only or affecting chat too? @maya can you check routing metrics?

maya (sre): looking now. Embeddings is the hotspot. Chat traffic steady. Rerank showing increased latency but low errors. Looks like batching/backpressure on embedding workers.

sam (oncall): ok. Plan: 1) throttle embeddings per-route qps to 30rps 2) reduce default token_window for embeddings jobs to 512 3) disable rerank route for non-critical customers 4) roll limit changes live and monitor for 10m. Applying step 1 now.

sam (oncall): running command:
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/configs/route-limit" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","qps":30}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started — route-limiter update job #4875. Logs: queued -> running.

deploy-bot: update complete on us-west1 nodes. 24/24 applied.

sam (oncall): verifier: monitoring shows embeddings error rate dropping to 4.2% in next minute. p95 down to 0.9s. still above baseline though.

maya (sre): running a targeted cache warmup on KV caches for embeddings to reduce cold misses. Triggering:
```
python tools/cache_warmup.py --target /v1/embeddings --shards us-west1 --rate 50
```

jon (infra): I see a spike in GPU memory pressure on pool-emb-1 correlated with kernel selector fallback to a slower FP16 path. Suspect model variant fallback causing pressure. Rolling kernel rollback is risky now.

maya (sre): hold on rollback — let's avoid churn. Instead, scale up embeddings pool by +2 nodes temporarily. Sam, can you request burst capacity?

sam (oncall): requesting burst: `POST /dedicated/burst?pool=embeddings&nodes=2` (internal). Provisioning now.

deploy-bot: burst provisioned, nodes joining.

sam (oncall): error rate stabilized ~1.2% now. Good signal.

zara (support): heads up — two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, Finlytics) reported degraded embeddings quality/timeouts. We should send quick note to accounts. I'll draft status update after final confirmation.

maya (sre): seeing heavy-tail retries from mobile clients due to 429s after the throttle. We should add per-customer exceptions to prevent enterprise app impact.

sam (oncall): executing per-client rule: increase qps for AcmeCorp api-key -> 60rps; Finlytics -> 50rps. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/quotas" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"api_key":"ACME-***","route":"/v1/embeddings","qps":60}'
```

deploy-bot: quota updates applied.

sam (oncall): also reducing embeddings max_batch_size from 1024 -> 256 to smooth latency. Applying:
```
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap embeddings-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"256"}}'
```

deploy-bot: configmap patched; runtime rolling restart of embedding workers started.

sam (oncall): note: this will increase CPU overhead but should flatten latency spikes and lower 5xx.

jon (infra): FYI rerank feature flagged to opt-in only. We'll flip flag for non-paid tenants off to reduce load. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/feature-flag -d '{"feature":"rerank","state":"off","scope":"non_paid"}'
```

sam (oncall): 10min check: embeddings error rate = 0.6%, p95 = 0.55s, overall token usage down ~12%. Keeping throttles and burst in place for 30m of stable metrics before reverting.

zara (support): posting status page note: "Degraded embeddings latency for some customers in us-west1. Mitigations in progress; no data loss. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes." Pinged AcmeCorp and Finlytics privately.

maya (sre): can we also add a traffic-shape rule to prioritize chat over non-interactive batch embeddings? If we deprioritize background embed jobs by assigning a lower scheduling class it should free capacity for low-latency routes.

sam (oncall): good call. Adding scheduling label on API: set header `x-priority: high` for chat, `x-priority: low` for embeddings-batch. Patching routing policy now.

deploy-bot: scheduling policy update rolled.

maya (sre): watching metrics — chat unaffected, embeddings stable. No new 5xx in last 12m.

sam (oncall): starting handoff to night oncall @jon in 30m. Logging actions taken into incident ticket #INC-2026.

sam (oncall): summary for handoff:
- Root cause: sudden batching/backpressure + kernel fallback causing memory pressure on embeddings pool in us-west1.
- Actions: per-route qps throttle (30rps), per-customer exceptions (Acme=60, Finlytics=50), reduced max_batch_size -> 256, disabled rerank for non-paid tenants, provisioned +2 nodes burst, caching warmup, scheduling priority for chat.
- Current state: error rate 0.5-1%, p95 0.5-0.7s, nodes healthy.
- Next steps: monitor for 1h, revert throttles gradually if stable, follow-up RFC for kernel selector rollback safety.

sam (oncall): handing to @jon now. All logs and commands in incident ticket #INC-2026.

jon (infra): ack. I'll take over. If anything spikes ping pager. Good run team :thumbsup: 

zara (support): I'll send customers an updated ETA and include mitigation details.

end.
